metadata.origin: Original controlled sentence generation; structures constructed with each sentence, not produced by Seman2
metadata.caveat: This is an initial development corpus, not a human-reviewed gold treebank. A construction can have legitimate alternative attachments. Tree node roles are functional labels, not automatic mappings to any SuperParser rule id.
metadata.structure: Full ordered constituent trees with category, role, character span, text, children and POS leaves
metadata.usage: Evaluate phrase spans, categories, attachments and roles via an adapter. Stratified group splits are provided but share sentence construction templates, so they are not a fully independent out-of-distribution benchmark.
metadata.evaluation_warning: Development/validation/test share controlled templates; test is useful for regression but is not an out-of-distribution generalization measure.
